skill.name: design-md
skill.description: Analyze Stitch project screens and generate a semantic DESIGN.md design system guide.
skill.summary: Creates prompt-ready DESIGN.md documentation from Stitch project screens.

security_audit.summary: The static findings are false positives caused by Markdown code spans, fenced examples, benign documentation URLs, and design-analysis language. No evidence found of shell execution, unauthorized upload, system reconnaissance, prompt injection, or data exfiltration in SKILL.md. The skill does request user-authorized Stitch MCP data and optional URL downloads, so users should provide only projects they are allowed to analyze.

content.value_statement: Design teams need consistent prompts for Stitch projects. This skill analyzes project screens and produces a DESIGN.md guide with colors, typography, components, and layout rules.
actual_capabilities: Discovers Stitch MCP namespaces and project identifiers when available.
Retrieves screen metadata, HTML, screenshot links, and design theme data.
Extracts colors, typography, geometry, depth, and layout principles.
Converts technical Tailwind and CSS values into design language.
Generates a structured DESIGN.md outline for future Stitch prompts.
limitations: Requires access to a configured Stitch MCP server.
Needs at least one completed screen to infer design patterns.
Generated output depends on the quality of metadata, HTML, and screenshots.
Does not automatically run visual QA or accessibility audits.

use_cases.title: Document Existing Projects
use_cases.description: Create a DESIGN.md from a Stitch project so future screens keep the same colors, typography, and layout rules.

use_cases.title: Translate UI Implementation
use_cases.description: Turn HTML, Tailwind classes, and screen metadata into design language that non-engineers can review.

use_cases.title: Standardize AI Prompts
use_cases.description: Build a reusable design reference for teams that prompt Stitch to create related screens.

prompt_templates.title: Start From Project Name
prompt_templates.prompt: Use design-md with my Stitch project named [project name]. Find the project, analyze the main screen, and draft DESIGN.md.

prompt_templates.title: Use Known IDs
prompt_templates.prompt: Use design-md with project ID [project ID] and screen ID [screen ID]. Document colors, typography, components, and layout rules.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Related Screens
prompt_templates.prompt: Use design-md to analyze screens [screen A] and [screen B] in project [project ID]. Identify shared rules and separate exceptions.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare Reusable Prompting Guide
prompt_templates.prompt: Use design-md to create a DESIGN.md for [project]. Prioritize semantic color roles, component behavior, spacing principles, and prompt-ready wording.

output_examples.input: A Stitch project called Furniture Collection with a completed home screen.
output_examples.output: A DESIGN.md draft with project identity, warm neutral colors, serif headings, product cards, and spacing rules.

output_examples.input: A project ID and screen ID for a mobile onboarding flow.
output_examples.output: A mobile-focused design guide covering dimensions, button shapes, field styles, hierarchy, and reusable screen language.

output_examples.input: Two related dashboard screens from the same Stitch project.
output_examples.output: A consolidated design reference that separates global patterns from screen-specific layout choices.

best_practices: Give project and screen IDs when available to reduce lookup errors.
Review generated language against the actual screenshot before reuse.
Analyze more than one screen when the project has varied layouts.
anti_patterns: Do not analyze projects without permission from the owner.
Do not treat one unfinished screen as a complete system.
Do not remove exact color values from the final guide.

faq.question: What does this skill create?
faq.answer: It creates a DESIGN.md-style guide that describes a Stitch project design system in prompt-ready language.

faq.question: Does it require Stitch MCP access?
faq.answer: Yes. It expects access to the Stitch MCP server for project, screen, and design theme data.

faq.question: Can it work from only a screenshot?
faq.answer: A screenshot can provide context, but HTML and metadata produce stronger design documentation.

faq.question: Does it generate app screens?
faq.answer: No. It prepares design documentation that can help future Stitch screen prompts stay consistent.

faq.question: Which tools can use it?
faq.answer: It is listed for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What data should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide a project name or IDs, target screens, and permission to retrieve relevant Stitch assets.
